text:
alex: Heads-up — eu-central dedicated pool fc-eu-2 is at 97% GPU util, queue length spiked to ~4200. 99th latency creeping up. Seeing some requests queued >8s.

maria: Which route policy is handling overflow? fallback to hosted should've kicked in.

alex: Overflow started but we hit the hosted-spend cap for that org so a portion of traffic is still stuck on dedicated. routing logs: `route(eu, dedicated)->reject->retry` loop for several tenants.

siddharth: Copy. Quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n dedicated-eu` shows no obvious crashloops; autoscaler reports desired>max for pool. Also `redis:queue:dedicated-eu` depth=4200.

ops-bot: ALERT: dedicated-pool-fc-eu-2 util=97% queue=4200 p95=1.9s p99=8.1s — incident auto-created #INC-2026-184.

jen: For short-term mitigation we should: 1) bump hosted fallback weight for eu region 2) deprioritize best-effort tenants (non-SLA) 3) open manual scaling to add 2 GPUs to fc-eu-2. Anyone object?

paul: +1 to (1) and (2). Manual scale is fine but cost team warned about burst over budget — we should prefer hosted fallback if it reduces tail.

alex: I can flip the weights now. doing small step (+30% hosted weight) and mark tenants with tag `tier:best-effort` to low priority.

siddharth: Runbook snippet to update routing:
```bash
# increase hosted fallback weight for eu
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/v1/routing/weights" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"region":"eu-central","hosted_delta":0.3}'
```

alex: executed the curl above — response 200. route-config shows hosted_weight +0.3.

ops-bot: ACTION: routing change applied by alex — hosted_weight eu-central +0.3.

alex: Early metrics: queue depth down to ~800 in 3m, p99 down to 3.2s. Hosted throughput increased accordingly.

maria: Nice. Can we also flip prefix/KV cache eviction thresholds to free memory on dedicated? Some tenants keep large KV sessions.

siddharth: Good call — reducing per-tenant KV retention to 20s for non-SLA will free ~12% mem. Doing patch now.

jen: Please also tag the tenants that were blocked so we can run a targeted retry later. We don't want duplicate charges.

paul: Reminder: if we stay on hosted fallback >30min we hit monthly overage alert for the org. Document the cost delta in the incident ticket.

alex: Manual scale request submitted to infra-provisioning queue to add 2x A10s to fc-eu-2. ETA ~12m.

ops-bot: PROVISION: manual add request queued (job id prov-8793).

maria: If provision completes we'll gradually move weights back. For now keep hosted weight elevated and monitor error rates (5xx).

alex: After prov-8793 submission, queue down to ~420, p99 ~1.6s. No spike in errors.

siddharth: Also enabling eviction of older KV keys: `service-config.kv.retention.non_sla=20s` applied.

jen: Good. Can someone open a capacity ticket for long-term: fc-eu-2 needs +8 GPUs and possible AZ spread? We can't rely on hosted fallback forever.

paul: I'll own that ticket. I'll include cost/committed impact and recommend a scheduled capacity bump in next sprint.

alex: Noting action items in the incident: 1) revert hosted weight gradually after nodes up 2) tag and retry blocked tenants 3) postmortem on why autoscaler didn't spin enough nodes 4) cost impact calc.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: incident INC-2026-184 — mitigation in place. monitoring for 60m.

maria: Thanks. If anything regresses @here.

alex: :thumbsup: created postmortem stub at https://phabricator.redwood/INC-2026-184/pm

jen: TL;DR: weightswitch + KV eviction bought us time; manual scale to follow; we'll file autoscaler fix.

paul: Will track cost impact and escalate to finance if hosted overage expected.

ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: dedicated pool fc-eu-2 capacity restored (manual add complete). Hosted weight reverted to normal after steady state. final queue=12 p99=0.6s.

alex: Closing thread, will add details to postmortem.
